stories.title: Fire destroys 60 shops in Pune's Timber Market, no casualties reported
stories.summary: A devastating fire engulfed around 60 shops in Pune's Timber Market early Wednesday morning. Swift action from the city fire brigade, which dispatched over 27 fire tenders and around 150 firefighters, brought the blaze under control. Thankfully, all workers and shopkeepers escape
